candidate_reading_notes.note: Directly describes steady growth of the PDB Core Archive, including over 11,000 new structures in 2017. The statistic covers the archive, not uniquely identified protein-only structures or an effect-size estimate for the target approach.
Resource identity and archive scope include proteins, DNA/RNA and complexes. Do not carry over the different point-2 unique-protein/count dispute as this point's classification.
Affiliations, reference-list fragments and funding metadata are not direct support for the growth/benefit assertion. No fragment was deleted or replaced.
Archive quality/management and data growth context must not be rewritten as a quantified benefit to this specific evolutionary approach.
